chunks: From him, from his father, from al-Nawfali, from al-Sakuni, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:

The Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) passed by a man who had a garment with him that he was selling. The man was tall and the garment was short, so he said, 'Sit, for it will be more profitable for your merchandise.'
ai.seo_question: What is the prophetic advice regarding the display of goods for sale?
ai.summary: Recorded in Shaykh al-Tusi’s *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* within the chapter on leases and rentals, this hadith illustrates the Prophetic emphasis on optimizing commercial presentation to ensure fair value. By advising the tall merchant to sit, the Prophet (peace be upon him and his family) demonstrated that practical adjustments in display can enhance the perceived quality and profitability of goods, a principle foundational to Islamic trade ethics.
